title: [groups] names: wildmat pattern support with negation
description:
## Why

Currently `[groups] names` in transit.toml only accepts fully-qualified group names (e.g. `comp.lang.rust`). Operators need to express policies like "all of comp.*", "everything except alt.binaries.*", or "sci.* but not sci.crypt". Without wildmat support, operators must enumerate every group explicitly — impractical for large hierarchies.

## What

Add RFC 3977 wildmat pattern support (§4.1) to `[groups] names`:

- `*` — match any sequence of characters within a component or across dots
- `?` — match any single character
- `!` prefix — negation; exclude groups matched by this pattern
- Patterns evaluated in order; first match wins
- Bare group names continue to work as exact-match patterns

### Examples

```toml
[groups]
names = [
  "comp.*",          # all of comp hierarchy
  "sci.*",           # all of sci hierarchy
  "!alt.binaries.*", # except binary groups
  "alt.test",        # one specific group
]
```

## Scope

- Parse and validate patterns in `GroupsConfig`
- Implement wildmat matching (RFC 3977 §4.1 semantics)
- Apply pattern matching at ingestion: accept article if any Newsgroups entry matches
- Subscribe gossipsub to the right per-hierarchy topics based on which hierarchies patterns can match
- Reject config that has only negation patterns and no positive patterns (would accept nothing)
- Integration test: wildcard accept, negation exclude, order-dependent resolution
